sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Who dares stand idle on the harvest plain
While all around him waves the golden grain?
And to each servant does the Master say,

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Claim the high calling angels cannot share;
To young and old the gospel gladness bear;
Redeem the time; its hours too swiftly fly.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: No time for rest; till glows the western sky,
Till the long shadows o'r our pathway lie,
And a glad sound comes with the setting sun,
